title: Wind Waker Multiplayer mod manifest (mod.json), wwapi v0 UNSTABLE
description: Every mod embeds one mod.json with go:embed. tools/validate_manifests checks each against this schema in CI, and wwapi.ParseManifest checks it again at run time. See docs/api/02-mods.md.

$schema.description: Lets an editor find this schema. Ignored.

id.description: The mod's id. It equals the mod's folder name under mods/, and a leading _ marks a test fixture. It is the mod's event namespace (mod.<id>.*), so it follows the event-name rules, and it cannot be core.

api.description: The wwapi versions the mod works with, as a range, for example ^0.1.

dependencies.description: Mods this mod needs: id -> version range. Each is initialised before this mod.

optional_dependencies.description: Mods this mod uses when they are present and enabled: id -> version range. When present, the version must match and they are initialised first.

load_order.description: Breaks ties in the load order between mods that do not depend on each other: lower first, then by id. Default 0.

dev.description: A development mod: off unless dev mods are shown. Default false.

game_ids.description: The discs the mod is for. Empty means any. Checked by the contract check (later).

multiplayer.description: client_required: every player needs it (it counts in mods_hash). host_only: only the host runs it. local_only: it never touches the network. Default local_only.

provides.description: Roles the mod fills. At most one enabled mod provides each role; net is the network session provider.

needs.description: Features of the patched blob the mod needs. A missing one gives the mod NEEDS_REPATCH.

writes.description: Placeholder for the address set the mod may write (design decision 10). Ranges are [start, end) in MEM1; they may not overlap each other or another enabled mod's. Nothing enforces writes yet: wwapi/write comes later.

c.description: Reserved for C modules (Phase E). Must be null.
